meta.title: ProPitch Asia — Connecting elite football with Southeast Asia
meta.description: ProPitch Asia connects elite European football with Southeast Asia through advisory, international tours, ventures and premium experiences — facilities, pathways and partnerships built with the region.
meta.ogDescription: Advisory, international operations, ventures and experiences — football development infrastructure for Southeast Asia.

whyAsia.title: Building the future of football in Asia.
whyAsia.p1: Southeast Asia already over-indexes on European football fandom — it just watches from the outside. ProPitch Asia exists to turn that audience into infrastructure: facilities, pathways, partnerships and programming built with the region rather than sold into it.
whyAsia.p2: We work across four divisions — advisory, international operations, ventures and experiences — so a club, federation or investor can enter the region through whichever door fits their ambitions.
whyAsia.stat1Lbl: Football fans across Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam & Singapore
whyAsia.stat2Lbl: Cumulative Premier League TV audience across the region, 2021/22 season
whyAsia.stat3Lbl: Every Premier League match broadcast live across six SEA markets
whyAsia.stat4Lbl: Combined population across ASEAN — young, mobile-first, football-literate

advisory.title: Facility & football-development consulting
advisory.intro: From world-class pitches to world-class partnerships — we advise clubs, federations and investors on the infrastructure and pathways elite football is built on.
advisory.p1: Surface specification, drainage, floodlighting and technical-area layout for training grounds and academies.
advisory.p2: Age-group curricula, coach licensing pathways and periodisation frameworks built for local federations.
advisory.p3: Club licensing, youth-category regulation and AFC/regional-body compliance support.
advisory.p4: Regional talent identification systems, trial structures and data pipelines for recruitment teams.
advisory.p5: Structuring club, kit and title-sponsor partnerships, and connecting regional brands with the right football properties across the region.

international.title: Club tours, camps & exhibition matches
international.intro: Where world football meets Asia — we plan and deliver the on-the-ground programme, market by market.
international.tourDesc: Multi-city itineraries with training sessions open to local academies.
international.campDesc: Federation-endorsed camps run to the visiting club's own coaching curriculum.
international.exhbDesc: Stadium partnerships, matchday operations and broadcast coordination.
international.schlDesc: Community sessions run alongside every tour, camp and exhibition leg.

ventures.title: Projects, partnerships & investments
ventures.intro: Football development without borders — the deal-flow side of the business, from facility joint ventures to format IP.
ventures.v1Desc: Facility development with local landholders & federations
ventures.v2Desc: Regional rights packaging for club & format content
ventures.v3Title: Minority stakes in regional clubs & academies
ventures.v4Title: Format IP — ASEAN Football Star Hunt
ventures.v4Desc: Talent-search television format, see Experiences below

experiences.title: Events & premium football programmes
experiences.intro: Where the audience meets the game — matchday hospitality, festivals and our flagship regional format.
experiences.starHuntDesc: One club. Five nations. A live search for Southeast Asia's next professional footballer — ending on the biggest stage the region has to offer.
experiences.prog1Desc: Curated matchday programmes for partners and sponsors across the region's biggest fixtures.
experiences.prog2Desc: Multi-club community festivals run alongside tours, camps and academy partnerships.
experiences.prog3Desc: Short-term placements connecting regional coaching staff with partner academies in Europe.

contact.intro: Whether it's a facility masterplan, a tour itinerary, a partnership or the next season of Star Hunt — tell us which division fits, and we'll take it from there.
contact.faq1A: A Bangkok-based group connecting elite European football with Southeast Asia — facilities, pathways, partnerships and programming built with the region, not sold into it.
contact.faq2A: Advisory (facility and development consulting), International (tours, camps, exhibition matches), Ventures (partnerships and investments), and Experiences (events and premium programmes).
contact.faq3A: Clubs, federations, investors and brands seeking a structured entry into Southeast Asian football across advisory, operations, deal-flow or fan-facing programming.
contact.faq4Q: How do we get in touch?
contact.faq4Html: Email hello@propitch.asia and name the division that matches your brief.

acceptedAnswer.text: ProPitch Asia is a Bangkok-based group that connects elite European football with Southeast Asia — turning regional fandom into infrastructure: facilities, pathways, partnerships and programming built with the region.

mainEntity.name: What divisions does ProPitch Asia operate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Four divisions: ProPitch Advisory (facility and football-development consulting), ProPitch International (club tours, camps and exhibition matches), ProPitch Ventures (projects, partnerships and investments), and ProPitch Experiences (events and premium football programmes).
The company is focused on Southeast Asia, with operations and partnerships across the region and a registered office in Bangkok, Thailand.

mainEntity.name: How can clubs or investors contact ProPitch Asia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email hello@propitch.asia with the division that fits your goals — advisory, international, ventures or experiences — and the team will follow up.
